keys.swarm.aura_guardian_spirits_desc: Spirits stand guard around you, circling slowly. They strike and shove back the monsters they meet, and destroy enemy bolts that fly into them.
keys.swarm.aura_guardian_spirits_up: More spirits (3 at level 4, 4 at level 7), harder shoves.
keys.swarm.aura_guardian_spirits_ten: Ancestors' Ring: a full ring of 8 ancestor spirits guards you.
keys.swarm.aura_sunburst_desc: A ring of sun rays bursts out from you, burning and blinding each monster they pass.
keys.swarm.aura_sunburst_up: More rays reaching further, more often.
keys.swarm.aura_sunburst_ten: Dawnbreak: a sun hangs over you, firing a turning wheel of 12 rays and scorching what is near.
